entity.name: Order notifications are fire and forget copy

values.value: Order notifications are fire and forget
Serves the quality attribute requirement 'Order status within two seconds': status within 2 s at p95. Also serves fault isolation: a slow channel never slows the order.

Edges order-to-notification, order-to-email and order-to-push, from OrderService to NotificationService, EmailGateway and MobilePush. replyRequired: false. OrderService does not wait for or use a reply, and status reaches the customer within 2 s at p95.
